records.text: If my heart pursued another man’s wife, and I became one lying in wait at her doors,
may my wife also please another, and may my infants be humbled.
For defiling a man’s wife is an unrestrainable fury of wrath;
for it is a fire burning through every part; wherever it comes, it destroys from the roots.
Saul recognized David’s voice and said, “Is this your voice, child David?” David said, “Your servant, lord king.”
He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant in this way? How have I sinned, and what wrong has been found in me?

Now please let my lord the king hear his servant’s word. If God is stirring you up against me, may He smell your sacrifice. But if human beings have done so, cursed are they before the Lord, for they have expelled me today from being established in the Lord’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods.’
Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, child David, for I will not harm you, because my soul was honoured in your eyes today. I have acted vainly and been very ignorant.”
David answered, “Here is the king’s spear. Let one of the young men come across and take it.
The Lord will repay each his righteous deeds and faithfulness, for the Lord handed you into my hands today, but I was unwilling to bring my hand against the Lord’s anointed.
Behold, as your soul was magnified in my eyes today, on this day, so may my soul be magnified before the Lord. May He shelter me, and He will rescue me from every affliction.”
Saul said to David, “Blessed are you, child. You shall surely accomplish, and you shall surely be able.” David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
See what kind of love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God—and we are. For this reason the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.
Do not bring an impious person to the pasture of the righteous, and do not be deceived by a filled belly;
Know this, my beloved brothers: let every person be quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger,
for a man’s anger does not accomplish the righteousness of God.
For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror,
for he looked at himself and went away and immediately forgot what he was like.
But the one who looks closely into the complete law, the law of freedom, and continues in it—not a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work—will be blessed in what he does.
so they will cry to the Lord, but He will not listen to them. He will turn His face away from them at that time, because they acted wickedly in their practices against them.
The Lord lives! Blessed be my Guard! My God, the Guard of my salvation, will be exalted!
The mighty Lord gives me vengeance and disciplines peoples beneath me,
He grants great deliverances to His king, showing mercy to His anointed, to David and his descendants for ever.”
Again He reproved him with weakness upon a bed, and the multitude of his bones grew numb,
and he will certainly be unable to receive any edible food, although his soul will desire something to eat,
until his flesh decays and exposes his bones empty.
His soul drew near to death, and his life was in Hades.

If there are a thousand death-bearing angels, one of them will certainly not wound him. If he understands in his heart to turn toward the Lord, announces his own blame to a human, and shows his lack of understanding,
The Lord gives me a tongue of instruction, to know the right time when a word must be spoken. He appointed morning for me; He added an ear for me to hear,
For the One who justified me draws near. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him stand against me together. Who is bringing a case against me? Let him approach me.
Behold, the Lord helps me. Who will harm me? Behold, all of you will grow old like a garment, and it will devour you like a moth.
Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite replied: “I am younger in time, and you are older; therefore I kept quiet, afraid to announce my own knowledge to you.
“Nevertheless, Job, hear my words and give ear to my speech.
For behold, I opened my mouth, and my tongue spoke.
My heart is pure in words, and the understanding of my lips will perceive pure things.
Divine spirit is what made me, and the Almighty’s breath is what teaches me.
